objective: Advance A-grade research and the fresh A1->A2->A3 lane without repeating invalid lineage, future-information, source-granularity, provider, no-effect, or multiple-testing errors.

a5_next_axes.implementation_guard: All speed states must be computable from information available at the original completed-bar decision timestamp. No best-speed selection after outcomes; speeds are preregistered and evaluated jointly/leave-one-speed-out.
a5_next_axes.fresh_requirement: Direct original-fresh W123 A/B first; positive screening creates a new fresh challenger only.

a5_next_axes.block_reason: If persistence requires bars after the original signal, it changes entry timing and repeats the delayed-fill lineage error. It is blocked until a same-decision-timestamp causal definition exists.
a5_next_axes.implementation_guard: Use only lagged/completed-bar activity/liquidity proxies available at the parent decision timestamp. Do not label OHLCV/volume as L2 liquidity and do not admit a future-bar confirmation.
Persistence state must be formed entirely from completed bars at/before the original decision timestamp. No delayed fill and no outcome-selected trend age.
a5_next_axes.sample_guard: The six-trade perfect screening result is fragile; it can qualify a challenger but cannot seal a survivor.

a5_next_axes.implementation_guard: Use the completed signal bar and lagged band state only; preserve original Keltner geometry and risk. Relative-volume is not preferred after the break_and_continue no-effect and current microstructure critique.
a5_next_axes.source_guard: Any L2/adverse-selection claim requires native L2/trade-flow data; OHLCV-only band expansion is a volatility-state claim, not an order-book claim.

a5_next_axes.implementation_guard: Ablate exactly one preregistered component. Because ablation may admit new signals, evaluate a full exact-source same-window replay rather than filtering only the three original trades. No component search after outcomes.
a5_next_axes.sample_guard: The three-trade screening result cannot certify alpha or A1 survival.
